_comment1: Example relay tray config - copy to relay/tts_relay_config.json and edit. Every '_comment*' key is documentation only.
_comment2: default_backend picks the engine; default_checkpoint must be a model name of that backend (the tray falls back to the backend's first model otherwise).
_comment3: genie_characters entries map tray model names to Genie server characters; onnx_model_dir is required - the relay loads the character on switch and unloads the previous one (single resident voice). dq is an EXAMPLE of a private voice.
_comment4: max_chunk_chars caps per-queue-item length (GPU handles 180; CPU is happier with 90). prebuffer_s trades latency for stability on slow backends.

BreezeBlue(云端)._comment5: Cloud TTS (breeze.blue): streams raw s16le mono PCM at 24 kHz, bills per character (CJK 2 units, other 1; 10 units = 1 credit). api_key may also come from the BREEZE_API_KEY env var - prefer the env var over committing a key. Voices are declared in the top-level 'breeze_voices' dict, one entry per selectable tray voice.
BreezeBlue(云端).api_key: <your breeze.blue key or leave empty to use BREEZE_API_KEY>
